definition: Eight promotion paths in Heaven’s bureaucracy · revealing the Xiyouji world’s ‘class mobility’ mechanism · not a single channel

promotion_paths.requirement: Perfect one’s own cultivation · complete merit · transcend the mortal body
cases: Patriarch Bodhi (in seclusion)
Zhenyuan Daxian
Chan Master Wuchao
Erlang Shen (sanctified in the flesh)

promotion_paths.requirement: Perform great deeds · such as subduing demons / campaigning / protecting the Dharma
cases: Sun Wukong (enfeoffed Great Sage Equal to Heaven · later becomes a Buddha)
Nezha (enfeoffed Grand Deity of the Three Altars of the Sea)
Erlang Shen (enfeoffed King of Zhaohui Lingxian)
Li Tianwang (enfeoffed Grand Marshal of Demon Subjugation)

promotion_paths.requirement: Pass Heaven’s civil-service examination · civil and martial subjects
cases: Wenqu Star (palace examination graduate)
Wuqu Star (military examination graduate)
Kui Star (god of examinations)

promotion_paths.requirement: Recommended by senior immortals · or trained under a famous master
cases: Zhu Bajie (recommended by his master · became Marshal Tianpeng)
Sha Wujing (recommended by his master · became General of the Curtain-lifting)
White Dragon Horse (recommended by Guanyin · joined the pilgrimage team)

promotion_paths.requirement: Serve as a senior immortal’s mount · cultivate alongside one’s master · occasionally gain the chance to be promoted
cases: Green Ox Spirit (Laojun’s mount · descended to be a demon)
Golden-Maned Hou (Guanyin’s mount)
Green-Maned Lion (Mañjuśrī’s mount)
White Elephant (Samantabhadra’s mount)
promotion_paths.tier_target: T2-Demon Realm (descended) or return to mount status

promotion_paths.requirement: Mortals who perform great good or great loyalty · deified after death · or invested by Heaven
cases: Qin Shubao / Yuchi Gong (door gods)
Wei Zheng (beheads a dragon in a dream · the pinnacle of a minister)
Guan Yu (romance system · not the Xiyouji mainline)

promotion_paths.requirement: Invited to the Peach Banquet · eat peaches to prolong life · keep one’s divine register
cases: Heaven’s elite (regulars at the Peach Banquet)
Sun Wukong (invited once as Great Sage Equal to Heaven · later loses the privilege)
promotion_paths.tier_target: Maintains current tier · not a promotion · a life-extension mechanism

promotion_paths.requirement: Receive Taishang Laojun’s elixir · boost cultivation or save one’s life
cases: Sun Wukong (steals 5 gourds of elixir · attains an indestructible body)
Jade Emperor (endured 1750 kalpas · each 129,600 years · aided by elixir)

promotion_stats.highest_success_rate: Meritorious Enfeoffment (60%) · the mainstream promotion channel
promotion_stats.lowest_success_rate: Mortal Deification (1%) · traversable by very few
promotion_stats.mainstream_path: Meritorious Enfeoffment + Recommendation · covers most registered immortals in Heaven
promotion_stats.alternative_path: Cultivation to Immortality · the most autonomous but the lowest success rate
promotion_stats.structural_insight: Heavenly promotion runs on ‘merit + connections + lineage’ three tracks in parallel · not a single standard

promotion_insights: Meritorious Enfeoffment is the mainstream channel · 60% success rate · Sun Wukong’s enfeoffment as Great Sage Equal to Heaven followed this path
Recommendation is the hidden rule · 50% success rate · Zhu Bajie / Sha Wujing both entered Heaven’s upper ranks this way
Peach Longevity is not promotion · it is a life-extension mechanism · keeping one’s divine register from ‘retirement’
Elixir Promotion is a top resource · held by Taishang Laojun alone · extremely scarce
Mount Promotion has the lowest rate (2%) · revealing Heaven’s class ossification · mounts are ‘second-class citizens’
Mortal Deification is a bottom-up channel · but only 1% success · Qin Shubao / Yuchi Gong are rare cases
The Heavenly Examination exists but has few cases · showing Heaven values merit over examinations
Cultivation to Immortality is the ‘most orthodox’ but the hardest · Patriarch Bodhi / Zhenyuan Daxian are successes · but most cultivators fail
